task_description: Add AI-powered on-device pose detection using MediaPipe via react-native-vision-camera and react-native-mediapipe. Support 8 exercises with real-time rep counting, skeleton overlay visualization, and save workout results to Supabase. No video streaming - only final rep counts and set data are persisted.

verification.summary: NPM registry not accessible (403 Forbidden), so npm install/build/test cannot run. All 12 .js files pass node --check syntax validation.
